note: Every promise made to a user on the website home page, the README, the start page and llms.txt, with where it is made, what backs it and its status. complete = tests and (where the row says so) a recorded live run back it as worded; partial = built in part and the wording says so; stand-in = tested with stand-ins only and the wording says so; designed = a future-tense promise or a design. Every promise that is not complete cites a register row that is not closed AND carries a limit sentence in the same file (the `limit` field must appear in the file). The test packages/asp-cli/test/promises-audit.test.ts fails when a quoted promise disappears from its file, a row is unknown, a complete promise cites an open row, or a promise that is not complete has no open row or no stated limit.
